summary: Growing a directed MatrixGraph discards existing edges because the parent implementation swaps local slice references instead of their contents, then replaces the adjacency vector with the empty new vector. The fix moves actual elements within the expanded vector, processing rows backwards and handling overlapping slices safely. The regression test added by this commit checks that existing edges survive growth from capacity 4 to 8. This reversal isolates the edge-preservation correction; no tests were executed.
